# Cart Items

`commerce/cart-items` &middot; section-level &middot; category: commerce

## Purpose

The products in a customer's cart or order, repeated from Klaviyo event data with a for loop, each row with image, title, quantity and price.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | object { title, image, imageAlt, price, quantity } |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `itemsVariable` | text | `"event.extra.line_items"` |
| `alias` | text | `"item"` |
| `total` | text |  |
| `totalLabel` | text | `"Total:"` |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: One row per item: a small image, then the title, quantity and price.
- **large**: Bigger images (40/60). Sets `split: 40/60`.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `split` | text | `"25/75"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `rowPadding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each row is a media-text table row. | Rows stack on phones through a media query. Non-Google Gmail accounts keep the desktop layout. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('commerce/cart-items', {
  "heading": "Your cart",
  "item": {
    "title": "{{ item.product.title }}",
    "image": "{{ item.product.images.0.src }}",
    "imageAlt": "{{ item.product.title }}",
    "price": "{{ item.line_price }}",
    "quantity": "{{ item.quantity }}"
  },
  "total": "{{ event.extra.total_price }}",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Return to your cart",
    "href": "{{ event.extra.checkout_url }}"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "commerce/cart-items",
  "data": {
    "heading": "Your cart",
    "item": {
      "title": "{{ item.product.title }}",
      "image": "{{ item.product.images.0.src }}",
      "imageAlt": "{{ item.product.title }}",
      "price": "{{ item.line_price }}",
      "quantity": "{{ item.quantity }}"
    },
    "total": "{{ event.extra.total_price }}",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Return to your cart",
      "href": "{{ event.extra.checkout_url }}"
    }
  }
}
```
